entries: Your strikes drink the splattered blood of your foes. As part of casting this spell, you must expend five {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} or the spell automatically fails. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the numbered rolled.

name: Steal Immortality

time.condition: which you take when a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within range that you can see is reduced to 0 Hit Points

m.text: the skull of a humanoid encrusted in gems worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend nine {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. Roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell and gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice the roll's total. You gain the creature type of the spell's target, in addition to your own type.

While the spell lasts, you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition; you no longer need to eat, drink, or breathe; you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; and you gain a benefit based on your new creature type:

entries.name: Celestial
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Radiant and Necrotic damage and have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet.

entries.name: Elemental
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, and Thunder damage.

entries.name: Fey
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn, or teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

entries.name: Fiend
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold and Fire damage and have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet.

entries.name: Undead
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Necrotic damage, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.
You have the creature type and benefits until you cast the spell again, or you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Suffocate
entries: You create a pair of grasping hands made from {@condition invisible} force. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within range. On a hit, the creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. While it has this condition, it can't breathe.

A creature can hold its breath for a number of rounds equal to 1 plus its Constitution modifier (minimum of 30 seconds) before suffocation begins. When a creature runs out of breath, it gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level at the end of each of its turns. When a creature can breathe again, it removes all levels of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} it gained from suffocating.

A creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by the hands can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB}.

name: Summon Plant

m.text: a ceramic pot filled with herbs and fertilizer worth at least 200 GP

entries: You call forth a plant spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the {@creature Plant Spirit|GrimHollowPG24} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a floral feature: Blooming, Oaken, or Thorny. The creature resembles an animated plant marked by the chosen floral feature, which determines one of the traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its move to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Summon Sea Spirit

m.text: a bejeweled statuette of a sea serpent worth at least 300 GP

entries: You call forth an abyssal spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the {@creature Sea Serpent Spirit|GrimHollowPG24} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose an abhorrent feature: Enormous Mouth, Glowing Lantern, or Scaled Wings. The creature resembles a monstrous sea creature marked by the chosen abhorrent feature, which determines one of the traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its move to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Supernal Smite

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

entries: Your strike cause ambient magic surrounded a creature to collapse and detonate. The target hit by the strike takes an extra {@damage 4d6} Force damage from the attack. If the creature is {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} on a spell, that {@status Concentration|XPHB} is broken.

In addition, each ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

name: Theft of Vitae

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage

entries: Roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell. The triggering creature takes Necrotic damage equal to the result. You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the result plus the triggering damage, to a maximum of 15 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The maximum number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} you can gain from casting increases by 10 for each slot level above 2.

name: Thorn Armor
entries: When you cast this spell, a flexible exoskeleton covered in thorns appears around a willing target within range. The target gains {@dice 3d6} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. If a creature hits the target with a melee attack roll before the spell ends, that creature takes Piercing damage equal to the number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} lost as a result of the attack. This spell ends early if the target has no remaining {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} granted by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The target gains an additional {@dice 2d6} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Tremor
entries: The ground around you in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} begins to shake violently. You are unaffected by the tremors. The ground is considered {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and whenever the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} enters a creature's space, a creature enters the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, or the creature ends its turn there, the creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Undead Enthrallment

components.m: a clay pot filled with brackish water, another clay pot filled with grave dirt, and a black onyx stone worth 500 + GP for each corpse

entries: Choose a corpse, or a number or corpses, within range that are equivalent to the size of the creature you are animating (the GM determines how many corpses are required). Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an Undead creature. You can choose for the target to become an Undead creature of CR 3 or lower (the GM has the creature's game statistics).

On each of your turns, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you. (If you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one.) You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over 1 creature you have animated with this spell, rather than animating a new one. Any creature you have maintained with this spell for 30 days remains permanently under your control. You may only control a maximum of four creatures with this spell.

name: Vampiric Claws
entries: You sprout wicked claws. When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with the new growth, it deals {@damage 1d6} Slashing damage instead of dealing the normal damage for your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, and you use your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls rather than using Strength.

While the spell lasts, each time you deal damage with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} from the spell are lost when the spell ends.

name: Vibrating Humors
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Die} or the spell automatically fails. A creature you can see within 30 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes Thunder damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks from its blood vibrating loudly. To determine this damage, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} expended to cast this spell.
The target repeats the save at the end of each of turns, ending the spell on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You increase the damage by expending an additional {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Die} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Viscous Sheath
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend seven {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} or the spell automatically fails. Your body is wrapped in clotted blood. Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes Necrotic damage. To determine this damage, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

If a creature hits you with a Melee weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to have clots form around the weapon, entrapping it. The attacker must succeed on a Strength saving throw or the weapon sticks to you. If the attacker doesn't release the weapon, the creature has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition while the weapon is stuck. While stuck, the weapon can't be used. The target can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, freeing the weapon on a success. The creature can also release the weapon to end the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.
You can trap a number of weapons equal to the number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} expended to cast the spell. When the spell ends, the weapons are released.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can trap an additional weapon for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Wall of Gloom
entries: You create a wall of swirling gray energy, formed of the psychic pain of loss. The wall appears within range on a solid surface and lasts for the duration. You choose to make the wall up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick or a ringed wall that has a 20-foot diameter and is up to 20 feet high and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight.

The wall sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} out to a range of 100 feet. When you cast the spell, you and creatures you designate can pass through and remain near the wall without harm. If a creature moves within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.

A creature can move through the wall, though the attempt is emotionally draining. The first time a creature enters the wall on a turn or ends its turn there, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.

name: Weave Numen

m.text: a mithral sewing needle worth 300 GP+, which the spell consumes

entries: You can sense the presence of magic within 120 feet of yourself. You see a faint aura around any visible creature or object within that range that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any.
In addition, you gain thirteen threads. You can spend these threads to gain benefits as described below, with no action required unless stated:

items: When you cast a spell, you can expend 1 thread to enhance the spell as if you had expended a spell slot 1 level higher than you did and you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 1 plus the level of the spell.

When a creature you can see within 120 feet of you casts a spell, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend 1 thread to interrupt that spell. If it's a spell of level 3 or lower, the spell fails and has no effect. If it's a spell of level 4 or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC equals 10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect.

When you cast a spell that causes a creature to be healed or take damage, you can spend up to six threads. The amount of damage or healing caused to one creature by that spell increases by four times the number of expended threads.

entries: You lose all remaining threads when this spell ends. If you spend all threads granted by the spell, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You gain an additional two threads per spell slot level above 6.

name: Wilting Smite

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend two {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. The creature loses all Resistances to damage until the start of your next turn. The target hit by the strike takes extra Necrotic damage from the attack. To determine this damage, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell.

name: Wipe Face
entries: You curse a creature that you can see within range. The target's face is replaced with completely smooth skin, sealing the creature's eyes, nose, and mouth. The creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions and begins suffocating.

At the end of each of its turns, the target can attempt a Constitution saving throw to end the spell. Dealing at least 15 Slashing damage to the target opens an airway allowing it to breathe, but  the curse seals the opening at the start of your next turn.

name: Wrack
entries: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with excruciating muscle spasms for the duration. On a failed save, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

name: Antiballistics Field
entries: A 40-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} extends from you, disrupting projectiles and causing Ranged weapons to malfunction. Within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, whenever a Ranged weapon is used for an attack, the weapon immediately malfunctions and the attack is lost. A malfunctioning weapon can't be used to make an attack until a creature takes the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to fix the weapon malfunction. Ranged attacks using weapons whose projectiles pass through the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} and deal only half damage on a hit.

name: Ballistic Smite

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Ranged weapon

entries: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage. The target hit by the attack takes an extra {@damage 2d6} damage of the chosen type. The triggering attack can deal the chosen damage type or its normal damage type (your choice).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Concealed Shot
entries: A Ranged weapon you touch is made supernaturally subtle. For the duration, when you make a ranged attack using the weapon, the weapon or ammunition you're using becomes {@condition invisible} while in flight and the weapon becomes silent. If the weapon produces smoke or light, the spell suppresses these effects. The weapon or projectile you're using becomes visible again after the attack hits or misses. If you are hidden and the target is 80 feet or further from you, the attack doesn't reveal your location.

name: Conjure Cannonball
entries: You summon a cannonball, mid-flight and at full velocity, which explodes on impact. Make a ranged spell attack roll against a target you can see within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d10} Bludgeoning damage and an explosion extends from it in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each creature other than the target within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking half as much damage as the target on a failed save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each slot level above 3.

name: Conjure Cover
entries: You conjure a low cobblestone wall along the ground at a point you can see within range. The wall is 18 inches thick and is composed of three 5-foot-long, 3-foot-high segments. Each segment must be contiguous with at least one other segment.

A Medium creature that hunkers behind the wall has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover}, and a Small creature that hunkers behind it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover}. The wall can be leapt over without spending any additional movement.

Each segment has AC 10 and 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Reducing a segment of the wall to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} causes it to crumble, destroying it. The wall disappears when all the segments are destroyed or the spell ends.

name: Finger Guns
entries: You extend your forefinger and thumb, a dangerous gesture mimicking a gun. For the duration, your hand counts as a Simple Ranged weapon with a range of 60/240 feet and the {@itemMastery Slow|XPHB} mastery property. You can use your spellcasting ability instead of Dexterity for the attack rolls of this weapon. On a hit, the weapon deals {@damage 2d6} Force damage and doesn't add your ability modifier to damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The weapon's normal range increases by 30 feet and its long range increases by 120 feet when you reach levels 5 (90/360 feet), 11 (120/480 feet), and 17 (150/600 feet).

name: Jam Weapon

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within range makes an attack using a Ranged weapon

entries: The weapon you target suffers a malfunction and the attack fails. A malfunctioning weapon can't be used to make an attack until a creature takes the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to fix the weapon malfunction.

name: Jethro's Instant Reload
entries: One Ranged weapon you touch becomes enchanted to reload itself automatically. If the weapon has the {@itemProperty LD|XPHB|Loading} or {@itemProperty RLD|XDMG|Reload} property, you ignore the property for the duration. When the weapon's ammunition is depleted, ammunition you are carrying teleports into the weapon.

name: Perforating Shot

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting or missing with a ranged attack using a weapon

entries: As your attack hits or misses the target, the weapon or ammunition transforms into a 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} of magical energy that extends out to the weapon's normal range. The {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} includes the attack's original target. Each creature within the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Force damage equal to the weapon's normal damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The weapon's damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 1.

name: Arcane Capacitor
entries: You channel a wave of arcane power into your fingertips, recycling the leftover energy into a new spell slot. Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d10} force damage. Whether you hit or miss, you then regain one expended 1st-level spell slot

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 7th level spell slot, you instead regain an expended 2nd level spell slot. If you cast it using a 9th level spell slot, you instead regain an expended 3rd level spell slot

name: Boomering
entries: A dizzying ring of sparks launches from your outstretched hand and ricochets back to you moments later. Make a ranged spell attack roll against a creature within range. On a hit, you deal {@damage 3d6} radiant damage. If this attack misses, you can repeat the attack roll against the same target once

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|1-9|1d6} for each slot level above 1st

If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, after the ring hits the first target, it ricochets to a second target of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of the first target, dealing damage as normal on a hit. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the ring can ricochet to the third target of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of the second target. No matter how many creatures the ring ricochets to, you can only repeat the attack roll against one of the spell's targets

name: Burnt Offering
entries: By constructing a pyre and burning an animal's corpse, you court the favor of the gods. For the duration, you can add your Wisdom modifier, instead of your Dexterity modifier, to your Armor Class

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can also reroll one saving throw you make during the duration. You can choose to reroll the saving throw after you roll the die, but must decide before the outcome is determined and must use the new roll

name: Caustic Blade
entries: As part of the action used to cast this spell, you must make a melee attack with a weapon against one creature within the spell's range, otherwise the spell fails. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, except that any damage dealt by the attack is acid damage instead of its normal type. If you miss by 3 or less, acid splashes on the target, and you instead deal {@damage 1d8} acid damage.

This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an additional {@damage 1d8} acid damage to the target on a hit, and the acid damage dealt on a miss increases to {@dice 2d8}. Both damage rolls increase by one die at 11th level ({@dice 2d8} and {@dice 3d8}) and 17th level ({@dice 3d8} and {@dice 4d8}).

name: Cerebral Ray
entries: A translucent beam of violet light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d10} psychic damage and has disadvantage on ability checks until the beginning of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each slot level above 1st.

name: Chromatic Bullet
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack using a firearm during the spell's duration, your bullet sparks with elemental energy. The attack deals an extra {@damage 2d4} damage to the target. You choose whether this additional damage is acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder damage, and you can choose to change the firearm's damage to one of these damage types. You do not need to pick the same damage type for both

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d4|1-9|2d4} for each slot level above 1st

name: Dazzling Ray
entries: Three rays of brilliant color shoot from your hand at up to three creatures that you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target is {@condition blinded} until the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create one additional ray for each slot level above 2nd, to a maximum of 6 rays.

name: Dire Charm

m.text: nymph's eyelash, worth at least 100 gp

entries: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and has disadvantage unless you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is {@condition charmed} by you until the spell ends. If you or your companions do anything harmful to it, it can reattempt the saving throw. The {@condition charmed} creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was {@condition charmed} by you

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the duration becomes permanent (until dispelled)

name: Distort Gravity
entries: The spell manipulates the direction of gravity on a non-horizontal surface you touch, causing it to attract creatures and objects within 15 feet of it as if it were the ground. The surface can be up to a 60-foot square in area and can wrap around a structure, if its geometry permits. A creature can walk on this surface as if it were level ground, even if the surface is perpendicular to the ground or upside down.
When the duration ends, all creatures and objects fall from the surface.

name: Evasiveness
entries: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target gains a superhuman ability to dodge attacks. The target's AC becomes 20, if it were lower, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing, and it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

name: False Vision

components.m: a pinch of dust from a precious gem

entries: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from divination magic. The target can be a willing creature, a place, or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. If the target is targeted by any divination magic or perceived through a scrying spell's sensors, you are able to present the diviner with false information of your choice, as long as you are conscious at the time of the divination attempt. The target could appear to be in different circumstances, in one or more false locations, or completely undetectable

name: Flesh Ripper
entries: As you cast this spell, a spectral meat hook is flung at the creature of your choice, connected to a spectral chain. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} piercing damage as a spectral meat hook plunges into their body. Before the beginning of your next turn, if the target attempts to move more than 30 feet away from you, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be prevented from moving farther away until the beginning of your next turn. This effect ends and the meat hook disappears at the beginning of your next turn, or if you are further than 30 feet away from the target
This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach 5th level ({@dice 2d8}), 11th level ({@dice 3d8}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d8})

name: Glitterdust
entries: You spray golden particles in a 15-foot cone, covering all creatures and objects in that area. Each creature in the area must succeed a Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for the duration. A creature {@condition blinded} by this spell can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Each creature within the area, whether or not it succeeds on its saving throw, can't benefit from being {@condition invisible} for the duration.

name: Guided Missile
entries: You utter a prayer to guide your projectile, causing it to arc toward its target. The next ranged weapon attack you make before the spell ends has advantage and has double its normal and long ranges.

name: Hardlight Blaster
entries: You wave your hand and conjure a sophisticated arcane weapon, constructed of brilliant compressed light, which hovers in the air in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you. The weapon fires a crackling beam of energy at a target you choose within 60 feet of it, making a ranged spell attack using your spell attack bonus. The weapon is the point of origin for this attack; therefore, the attack can target a creature that isn't within your line of sight, as long as it is within the weapon's line of sight. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d6} force damage. After this attack, this weapon dissipates.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you deal an additional {@damage 1d6} lightning damage for each slot level above 1st.

name: Hardlight Gauntlet
entries: You conjure a scintillating gauntlet composed of compressed energy, and unleash a barrage of strikes. Make three melee spell attacks against a single target. On the first hit, the target takes {@damage 1d12} force damage, on the second hit, it takes {@damage 2d12} force damage, and on the third hit, it takes {@damage 3d12} force damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can make 1 additional attack; the fourth hit deals {@damage 4d12} force damage. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you make 2 additional attacks; the 5th hit deals {@damage 5d12} force damage.

name: Heart Of Darkness

components.m: A heart prepared with onyx and diamond dust worth at least 10,000 gp

entries: When you cast this spell, you stab a black, ritualistically-prepared human heart. The ichor from the heart infects the land with foul necromantic energies, causing up to one hundred piles of bones or corpses of Medium or Small humanoids within a 1-mile radius to rise from the dead, becoming {@creature skeleton|MM|skeletons} or {@creature zombie|MM|zombies} (the GM has the creatures' game statistics). The undead dig their way out of graves, smash their way out of mausoleums, and tear down cemetery gates.

The creature that is holding the heart can use its action to issue a general command to all undead created by the spell, such as to destroy a town or hunt down a particular creature. Only one general command can be issued to the undead every 24 hours. If not issued a command, the undead indiscriminately attack living creatures, other than the creature that is holding the heart and creatures designated by it. Once given an order, the undead continue to follow it to the best of their ability until the task is complete.
Even while you hold the heart, the undead are not directly under your control, and therefore don't count against any limitations of undead you can command.

The undead remain animated until the spell ends. The spell ends if the heart is destroyed (AC 20, HP 10, immunity to necrotic, poison, psychic damage) or targeted by a dispel magic spell cast as a 9th level spell. When the spell ends, all undead animated by it are instantly destroyed, crumpling into a heap. The spell also ends if every undead created by it is destroyed.

name: Ice Claw Prison
entries: You choose an unoccupied 10-foot square that you an see within range. A Large clawed hand made from razor-sharp ice appears there and lasts for the spell's duration. It acts at your command, though it cannot move from its initial location

The hand is an object that has AC 18 and hit points equal to half your hit point maximum. It has immunity to poison and psychic damage. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends. The claw doesn't fill its space. When you cast the spell and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns, you can command the claw to perform one of the following tasks:

{@b Slash}. The claw lashes out at a target within 10 feet of itself. Make a melee spell attack using your own spell attack bonus. On a hit, the target takes {@dice 3d8} slashing or cold damage (your choice.)

{@b Imprison. }The claw grabs a Large or smaller creature within 10 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be dragged into the claw's space and {@condition restrained} for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the {@condition restrained} target can make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, the target escapes and is no longer {@condition restrained} by the hand, but n a failure it takes {@damage 1d8} cold damage. While a creature is {@condition restrained} by the hand, the hand can't imprison or lash another creature. The claw can slash a creature it has {@condition restrained}.
{@b Release.} The claw releases an imprisoned target, which is no longer {@condition restrained}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage of the Slash and Imprison options increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot above 3rd.

name: Indemnify
entries: You fling a drop of blood at a target you can see within range, marking them for reckoning. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 1d8} radiant or necrotic damage (your choice) whenever you lose hit points for the duration. This spell ends early if the target begins its turn further than 60 feet from you.

name: Perforating Smite
entries: The next time you make an attack with a firearm before this spell ends, the shot is charged with an incredible amount of power. Instead of making an attack roll against a single target, the shot becomes a 5-foot wide line that extends from you out to the weapon's normal range. Each creature in that line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes the weapon's normal damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Pillar Of Salt

components.m: a drop of lantern oil and a pinch of sulfur

entries: You deliver a mote of divine wrath to a point you can see within range. Each creature you choose in a 10-foot radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 7d6} necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful save. If this damage reduces a target which failed its saving throw to 0 hit points, it is transformed into a pillar of salt.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 7d6|3-9|1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Protection From Ballistics
entries: A shimmering shield of energy surrounds one willing creature you touch. For the duration, ranged attacks made by firearms have disadvantage against the target, and the target has resistance to any damage dealt by firearms.

name: Ray of Warping
entries: A sapphire beam leaps forth from your fingertips, twisting and contorting the form of a creature it touches. Make a ranged spell attack roll against a target you can see within range. On a hit, the creature takes {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage, and for the duration, its speed is halved and its highest ability score is reduced to be the same as its lowest ability score (to a minimum of 3). If two or more of the creature's ability scores are tied for highest, you choose which ability score is reduced. The creature also has disadvantage on saving throws with its lowest ability scores. On its turn, the target can use its action to make a Constitution saving throw, ending this spell on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the initial damage increases by {@dice 1d8} per slot level above 3rd. Additionally, if you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the creature's second highest ability score is also reduced to be the same as its lowest ability score.

name: Repulsor Ring
entries: You outline a 5-foot diameter circle on the ground, which is warded against intruders. Only creatures you choose can step within the circle. Any ranged attack roll made against a target within the circle has disadvantage. If a hostile creature makes a melee attack against a target within the circle, the attacker is pushed back 10 feet immediately after the attack.

name: Snakestaff
entries: You cast a staff to the ground, which writhes and grows into a {@creature giant constrictor snake|MM} under your control, which acts on its own initiative count. The snake is friendly to you and your companions. The snake will obey any verbal commands that you issue to it (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands, it defends itself from hostile creatures, but otherwise takes no actions. If the snake is reduced to 0 hit points, it dies and reverts to a broken staff. The GM has the creature's statistics.

name: Tag
entries: You press your hand against a flat plane on an object and imprint an elaborate and vibrant image onto the surface. The image can contain a message up to three words in length, and can include art, caricatures, or identifying logos in any combination of colors, decided when you cast the spell. Nonmagical cleaning supplies cannot remove the image, which fades after seven days.

name: Thunderous Distortion
entries: You produce a distorted wave of noise in a 10-foot cone, which can be heard up to 100 feet away. Each creature in that area must succeed a Constitution saving throw, or take {@damage 1d6} thunder damage.
An echo of this noise persists until the end of your next turn. If you cast this spell again before the end of your next turn, its damage becomes d8s, instead of d6s
This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach 5th level ({@dice 2d6}), 11th level ({@dice 3d6}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d6}).

name: Time's Arrow

components.m: a physical missile weighing a pound or less, such as an arrow, bolt, or sling bullet

entries: This spell enchants a missile so that it freezes in time and space. You may reposition the missile as part of the action to cast the spell.

The missile remains frozen in place until either a creature passes within 120 feet in front of it, something touches it, a strong wind blows upon it, the enchantment is dispelled or the duration ends. At that point, the missile moves suddenly, as if it was just fired or thrown with a range of 120 feet. If a creature is in the line of fire, the missile makes an attack which adds your spell attack bonus to the attack roll, and does the basic damage of whatever missile type was used (missiles that vary by launcher use the highest possible damage dice).

name: Tyra's Coerced Karaoke
entries: As spectral instruments appear playing around you, you begin singing a well-known song and others feel compelled to join in. For the duration, when a creature comes within 30 feet of you or begins a turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw or begin singing along with you. A singing creature matches the pitch and words of the song as closely as it can, even if it can't speak the song's language. Furthermore, it can't speak normally (though it can still communicate telepathically) and it can't perform the verbal components of spells. Creatures that can't be {@condition charmed} are immune to this spell.
Unlike other spells, you can concentrate on this spell and the spell {@spell Otto's irresistible dance} at the same time. Losing your concentration on either spell ends both spells.

name: Unseen Accountant
entries: This spell creates an {@condition invisible}, shapeless force that performs intellectual tasks at your command until the spell ends. The servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It has AC 10, 1 hit point, an Intelligence of 12, and it can't attack. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends.

Once on each of your turns as a bonus action, you can mentally command the servant to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object. The accountant can perform intellectual tasks that a human clerk could do, such as assessing prices, updating accounts, managing inventories, or computing interest. Once you give the command, the accountant performs the task to the best of its ability until it completes the task, then waits for your next command. The accountant can perform no physical labor, and is not able to lift any object heavier than 1 pound.
If you command the accountant to perform a task that would move it more than 300 feet away from you, the spell ends.

name: Wildfire
entries: You create a magical fire that fills ten 5-foot cubes on ground, which you can arrange as you wish within range. Each cube you place must have a face adjacent to the face of another cube. On each of your turns after you cast this spell, you can use a bonus action to expand the area of the fire to up to ten additional 5-foot cubes that each have a face adjacent to the face of another cube of fire. The fire damages objects in the area and ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.

When a creature moves into the area of fire for the first time or starts its turn there, it must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes {@damage 8d8} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful save.

name: Proto-Abjuration
entries: A creature you touch gains one of the following benefits for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Some of the following benefits require that the spell is cast with a spell slot of a specified level or higher. Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in these benefits. If you use a level 4+ spell slot, you can choose two of the following benefits.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Arcane Thorns
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the target hits it with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes Force damage equal to {@dice 2d4} plus the spell's level.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Temporary Hit Points
entries: The target gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10 plus 5} times the spell's level. These {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} vanish if any remain when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Armored Ward (Level 2+ Spell Slot)
entries: The target has a +2 bonus to AC and saving throws for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Damage Resistances (Level 3+ Spell Slot)
entries: For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to one damage type of your choice: {@item Acid|XPHB}, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

name: Proto-Conjuration
entries: You create an impediment which fills a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. Choose one of the following options.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Some of the following benefits require that the spell is cast with a spell slot of a specified level or higher.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Obscured
entries: The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} by your choice of fog, foliage, or heavy rain.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Hazardous (Level 2+ Spell Slot)
entries: The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and contains thorny brambles, stone spikes, or icicles. When the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} appears, each creature in it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Piercing damage equal to {@dice 1d6} for each level of the spell slot expended on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes this save when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Grasping (Level 3+ Spell Slot)
entries: The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and contains living vines, tentacles, or webs that seize creatures within it. When a creature enters the affected area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the spell ends. A {@condition Restrained|XPHB} creature can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success.

name: Proto-Divination
entries: Choose one of the following options.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Some of the following benefits require that the spell is cast with a spell slot of a specified level or higher.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Omen
entries: You focus your mind on a past event, present circumstance, or a planned course of action and the GM delivers an omen. The omen is secretly hopeful, baleful, or neutral. A hopeful omen might be the sudden flight of a white bird or the sun appearing from behind the clouds, whereas a baleful omen could be a candle blowing out or a crow shrieking in the distance. Moreover, the GM can provide larger omens for more momentous occasions, such as a meteor shower or a red-colored rain. If you choose this option more than once before finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, there is a {@chance 50} chance that you get a random omen.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Premonition (Level 3+ Spell Slot)
entries: The GM offers you a non-literal or symbolic vision of an event that will occur within the next 24 hours. For example, to imply an imminent betrayal, the GM could present a {@item dagger|XPHB} stabbed into the back of a scarecrow or one of your possessions splattered with blood. Once you use this option, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Portent (Level 3+ Spell Slot)
entries: Roll {@dice 1d20} and record the number rolled. You can replace any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} made by you or a creature that you can see with the recorded number. You must choose to do so before the roll. You lose this recorded number when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} or use this option again.

name: Proto-Enchantment
entries: You attempt to manipulate the mind of a creature you can see within range using one of the following options.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Some of the following options require that the spell is cast with a spell slot of a specified level or higher.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Charm
entries: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for the duration. The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its saving throw if you or your companions are fighting it. The spell ends early if you or any of your companions do anything harmful to the target.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Frighten
entries: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for the duration. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Frenzy (Level 3+ Spell Slot)
entries: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frenzied condition for the duration. A creature with the Frenzied condition loses the ability to distinguish between friend and foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies. While Frenzied, the creature chooses the targets for its attacks, spells, and abilities randomly from among the creatures it can see within range, and it must make an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} if any creature provokes one. At the end of its turn, an affected creature can repeat its saving throw, ending the spell early on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Stun (Level 5+ Spell Slot)
entries: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

name: Proto-Evocation
entries: You unleash a blast of elemental energy. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage, and choose one of the following options.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Some of the following options require that the spell is cast with a spell slot of a specified level or higher. The damage of the Single-Target option increases by {@dice 1d12} for each spell slot level above 1, and the damage of the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}, {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}, and {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} options increase by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Single-Target
entries: Make a spell attack roll against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d12} damage of the chosen type.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cone (Level 3+ Spell Slot)
entries: Each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d8} damage of the chosen type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Line (Level 3+ Spell Slot)
entries: Each creature in a 90-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} originating from you makes  a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d8} damage of the chosen type on a failed save of half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Sphere (Level 3+ Spell Slot)
entries: Each creature in a 15-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d8} damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Proto-Illusion
entries: You create an illusion of an object, creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. The illusion appears at a spot within range and lasts for the duration.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can cause the illusion to move to any spot within range. As the illusion changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the illusion.

Physical interaction with the illusion reveals it to be an illusion, for things can pass through it. A creature that takes a {@action Study|XPHB} action to examine the illusion can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image and its other qualities fade.
The image is accompanied by one of the following effects of your choice.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Some of the following options require that the spell is cast with a spell slot of a specified level or higher.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Silent
entries: The illusion is purely visual. It isn't accompanied by sound, smell, or other sensory effects.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Realistic (Level 3+ Spell Slot)
entries: The illusion is accompanied by sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the things being depicted, but it can't deal damage or cause conditions.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Tangible (Level 4+ Spell Slot)
entries: The image is Realistic and also is filled with shadowstuff, causing it to be physically tangible. Physical interaction no longer reveals the image to be an illusion. The illusion has AC 15 and 1 HP, and vanishes if it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. For the duration, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cause the illusion to reappear, but a creature that witnessed the illusion vanish can discern that it is an illusion.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Damaging (Level 5+ Spell Slot)
entries: The illusion is Realistic and Tangible, and can deal damage. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can force a creature within 60 feet of the illusion to make an Intelligence saving throw, taking {@damage 4d8} Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that discerns the illusion for what it is has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against it.

name: Proto-Necromancy
entries: The spell animates an Undead servant. Choose a target and an associated Undead creature from the Proto-Necromancy table. The Undead dies when the spell ends.

The Undead is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the Undead shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its movement to avoid danger. The Undead uses your spell attack modifier for its attack rolls.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast the spell using a level 2+ spell slot, you can animate more powerful Undead as shown on the Proto-Necromancy table. Undead you create using this spell can't create additional Undead.

entries.caption: Proto-Necromancy
rows: Corpse of a Humanoid that has been dead for no longer than 1 hour
Pile of Giant or Monstrosity bones

name: Proto-Transmutation
entries: Choose one of the following options.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Some of the following options require that the spell is cast with a spell slot of a specified level or higher.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Transmute Liquid
entries: You touch a vessel containing 1 gallon of water, transmuting the contents into a vial of {@item Acid|XPHB} (4 ounces), a flask of {@item Alchemist's Fire|XPHB} (1 pint), a vial of {@item Basic Poison|XPHB} (4 ounces), 1 pint of honey, 1 a flask of {@item Oil|XPHB} (1 pint), 1 quart of vinegar, or 1 bottle of Common Wine.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Transmute Solid
entries: You touch one object that isn't being worn or carried, and transmute parts of that object that fit within a 1-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. You can only transmute parts composed entirely of crystal, glass, ice, iron, steel, stone, or wood, changing those parts into a different one of those materials of your choice. The AC for that part of the object changes accordingly.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Transmute Humanoid (Level 5+ Spell Slot)
entries: You touch a willing Humanoid to alter its appearance and species. The target can choose a new species, losing the traits of its original species and gaining the traits of its new one. The target also decides what it looks like, including its height, weight, facial features, sound of its voice, hair length, coloration, and other distinguishing characteristics.

name: Abduct
entries: This spell attempts to teleport a creature within range to your location. You must know the target's precise location when you cast this spell; if it is more than 100 feet from its supposed location while you are casting the spell, the spell fails. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of yourself. You can magically bind the target with nearby restraints, such as {@item Manacles|XPHB}, when it is teleported. When the spell ends, you choose whether the target remains in its location or if it is teleported back to the location from which it left.

name: Aberrate
entries: This spell causes your anatomy to become fluid. For the duration, any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against you becomes a normal hit.

Immediately after you take damage while this spell is active, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage type until this spell ends or until you take this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to a different damage type. This {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} doesn't apply to the triggering damage.

name: Accelerate/Decelerate

time.condition: which you take when you see an attack roll hit a creature within 60 feet of yourself

components.m: a drop of oil or molasses

entries: This spell accelerates or decelerates an attack (see the chosen effect below) the instant before it strikes, lessening or multiplying its force.

entries.name: Accelerate
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 2d6} damage from the attack. This extra damage is the same type dealt by the triggering attack.

entries.name: Decelerate
entries: Reduce the damage the target takes by {@dice 2d6} (to a minimum of 0 damage).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage or reduction in damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 1.

name: Accursed Act
entries: You attempt to curse a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be cursed for the duration. Until the spell ends, the creature takes Psychic damage equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your spellcasting ability modifier whenever it makes an attack roll or casts a spell. The target only takes this damage once per turn. The spell ends early if the target doesn't attack or cast a spell on its turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Action
entries: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. During its next turn, the target gains an additional action. That action can be used only to take the {@action Attack|XPHB} (one weapon attack only), {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Hide|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.

name: Aerial Alacrity

components.m: a feather from a bird of prey

entries: Target a willing creature you can see within range that has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} (including one with a temporary or magically bestowed {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB}). That creature gains the following benefits for the duration while it has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} and is flying:

items: The target can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
The target can hover.
The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity checks and saving throws.

name: After Image

m.text: a silver {@item Mirror|XPHB} worth 50+ GP

entries: You create an illusory duplicate of yourself which follows your every movement. When a creature hits you with an attack roll while your duplicate remains, roll a {@dice d6}. If it rolls a 3 or higher, the duplicate is hit instead of you and the duplicate is destroyed. The duplicate otherwise ignores all other damage and effects. The duplicate reappears if you move 15 feet or more on your turn or take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action.
A creature is unaffected by this spell if it has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition, {@sense Blindsight|XPHB}, or {@sense Truesight|XPHB}.

name: Antiballistics Field
entries: A 40-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} extends from you, disrupting projectiles and causing Ranged weapons to malfunction. Within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, whenever a Ranged weapon is used for an attack, the weapon immediately malfunctions and the attack is lost. A malfunctioning weapon can't be used to make an attack until a creature takes the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to fix the weapon malfunction. Ranged attacks using weapons whose projectiles pass through the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} and deal only half damage on a hit.

name: Arc Blade

m.text: a Melee weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP

entries: As lightning surges through the weapon used in the spell's casting, you make one attack. This attack can be a melee attack or ranged spell attack using the weapon with a range of 15 feet, as a wave of energy extends from the weapon. The attack uses your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If it is a ranged attack, it deals Lightning damage. Otherwise, it can deal Lightning damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: Whether you deal Lightning damage or the weapon's normal damage type, the attack deals extra Lightning damage when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 1d6}), 11 ({@dice 2d6}), and 17 ({@dice 3d6}).

name: Arc Blade

m.text: a Melee weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP

entries: As lightning surges through the weapon used in the spell's casting, you make one attack. This attack can be a melee attack or ranged spell attack using the weapon with a range of 15 feet, as a wave of energy extends from the weapon. The attack uses your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If it is a ranged attack, it deals Lightning damage. Otherwise, it can deal Lightning damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: Whether you deal Lightning damage or the weapon's normal damage type, the attack deals extra Lightning damage when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 1d6}), 11 ({@dice 2d6}), and 17 ({@dice 3d6}).

name: Arcane Anomaly
entries: You create a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you that distorts magical energy. For the duration, whenever a spell is cast within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 5 or 6, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

name: Ballistic Smite

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Ranged weapon

entries: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage. The target hit by the attack takes an extra {@damage 2d6} damage of the chosen type. The triggering attack can deal the chosen damage type or its normal damage type (your choice).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Benign Dismemberment
entries: You touch a willing creature, allowing its body parts (fingers, limbs, and even its head) to be harmlessly severed from its body for the duration. It takes no damage from such dismemberment, as long as the body part is removed swiftly and leaves a clean cut. The target's head remains alive and conscious, and parts connected to it also remain alive. All severed body parts become inanimate, but don't begin decomposition for the spell's duration. Any of the target's severed body parts that are removed during this spell's duration can be held back to the stump, which instantly restores the body part.
At the end of the duration, severed body parts become permanently severed. The target dies if vital organs have not been reattached to its head.

name: Blood Print

components.m: an ounce or more of blood

entries: At your touch, wet blood on a surface shifts and reforms into a pattern of crimson blotches. This blood print is unique to the particular creature to whom the blood belongs, but you can determine the creature's kind (such as Human, Gnoll, Deer, or Fire Giant) by examining the general shape. A print can be preserved by pressing a sheet of paper against it. If this spell is cast twice, it is possible to match blood samples originating from the same creature.

name: Blunder

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within range hits a target with an attack roll

entries: The attacker must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of the following effects of your choice:

entries.name: Fumble
entries: The target drops one object of your choice that it's holding, with the object landing in a space you choose up to 10 feet away from the target. If the target drops the weapon it is using for the attack roll, it can make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} for the triggering attack.

entries.name: Prat Fall
entries: The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. The {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} from the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition applies against the triggering attack, potentially causing it to miss.

name: Burning Blade

m.text: a Melee weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP

entries: Encasing the weapon used in the spell's casting in flames, you make one melee attack. The attack uses your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If the attack deals damage, it can be Fire damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice). If the weapon's damage die or any of the spell's damage dice roll the highest number, you can roll that die again and add it to the damage, rolling again if it is the highest number, and so on. You can add a maximum number of dice to the damage roll equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: Whether you deal Fire damage or the weapon's normal damage type, the attack deals extra Fire damage when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 1d6}), 11 ({@dice 2d6}), and 17 ({@dice 3d6}).

name: Candy Blast
entries: You summon a handful of hard candy—boiled sweets, mints, jelly beans, etc.—and hurl them at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Force damage and the candy forms a pile on the ground in its space, causing a 5-foot-square area of your choice in the target's space to become {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. The candy produced by this spell is edible but has no nutritional value, and vanishes after 1 minute, ending any {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

name: Card Trick
entries: With a flash of your hands, you fling a playing or tarot card charged with magical energy. Choose whether you make a ranged spell attack roll or if the target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a hit or a failed saving throw, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Force damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

name: Cheat
entries: You twist your fingers and fate seems to follow suit. Until the end of your next turn, you can reroll any ability check you make to play nonmagical games of skill and must use the new roll. Therefore, this spell could influence a game of poker, but not the result of a {@item Deck of Many Things|XDMG}.

name: Clue
entries: When you cast this spell, all footprints and fingerprints within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you become highlighted and glow faintly for the duration. When you cast the spell, choose any point in time up to 10 days ago. Only footprints and fingerprints left between that time and the present will be highlighted. Each creature that leaves footprints and fingerprints is assigned a unique color, but are not otherwise identified. Any creature that moves or touches objects within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} will also leave colorful footprints and fingerprints, which might reveal {@condition invisible} creatures in the area.

name: Concealed Shot
entries: A Ranged weapon you touch is made supernaturally subtle. For the duration, when you make a ranged attack using the weapon, the weapon or ammunition you're using becomes {@condition invisible} while in flight and the weapon becomes silent. If the weapon produces smoke or light, the spell suppresses these effects. The weapon or projectile you're using becomes visible again after the attack hits or misses. If you are hidden and the target is 80 feet or further from you, the attack doesn't reveal your location.

name: Conjure Cannonball
entries: You summon a cannonball, mid-flight and at full velocity, which explodes on impact. Make a ranged spell attack roll against a target you can see within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d10} Bludgeoning damage and an explosion extends from it in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each creature other than the target within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking half as much damage as the target on a failed save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each slot level above 3.

name: Conjure Cover
entries: You conjure a low cobblestone wall along the ground at a point you can see within range. The wall is 18 inches thick and is composed of three 5-foot-long, 3-foot-high segments. Each segment must be contiguous with at least one other segment.

A Medium creature that hunkers behind the wall has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover}, and a Small creature that hunkers behind it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover}. The wall can be leapt over without spending any additional movement.

Each segment has AC 10 and 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Reducing a segment of the wall to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} causes it to crumble, destroying it. The wall disappears when all the segments are destroyed or the spell ends.

name: Consecrated Armor
entries: You trace a holy symbol on yourself, creating an {@condition invisible} barrier until the spell ends. Your base AC becomes 12 plus your Dexterity modifier. If you are attacked by an Aberration, Fey, Fiend, or Undead, you add your spellcasting ability modifier to your AC against that attack. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

name: Corruption Curse
entries: With a piercing glare and a sinister gesture, you send ribbons of dark magic toward a creature you can see within range. For the duration, the target is cursed and suffers one of the following effects of your choice.

entries.name: Dull Reflexes
entries: The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity checks and saving throws.

entries.name: Feeble Fortitude
entries: The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws and can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Weak Will
entries: The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom saving throws and spell attack rolls.

name: Cosmic Horror
entries: For the briefest moment, you open a portal to an eldritch dimension in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you can see within range. Each creature within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes a Wisdom saving throw as it beholds the nightmarish dimension. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d6} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for the duration. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
A creature {@condition Frightened|XPHB} by this spell makes another Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Cryptogram
entries: You send a small scroll with a message to a creature of your choice. The recipient must be a creature known to you and also be on the same plane of existence as you. The scroll hovers in front of the recipient, drops into its pocket, or lands atop something nearby. The scroll's message can be up to 8 characters long (spaces count as characters). Once you send a scroll, you can't send another scroll to that recipient for 24 hours.

name: Curse Object

m.text: powdered onyx worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You bestow a curse upon an object that you touch. The object must be one that isn't being worn or carried and is able to fit within a 5-foot cube. Until the spell ends, the object becomes magical (requiring attunement) and cursed. The fact that the object is cursed is revealed only when an Identify spell is cast on it or a creature attunes to it. When a creature attunes to the object, the curse extends to it for the duration. Choose the curse from the following effects.

entries.name: Bleeding
entries: The attuned creature can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Frenzied (Weapon Only)
entries: Whenever the attuned creature deals damage with the cursed weapon, it has the Frenzied condition for 1 minute. A creature with the Frenzied condition loses the ability to distinguish between friend and foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies. While Frenzied, the creature chooses the targets for its attacks, spells, and abilities randomly from among the creatures it can see within range, and it must make an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} if any creature provokes one.

entries.name: Hobbled
entries: The attuned creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved and can't take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

entries.name: Obsessed
entries: The attuned creature is unwilling to part with the object, keeping it on its person at all times. If the cursed object is a weapon, the attuned creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls with weapons other than the cursed weapon.

entries.name: Restless
entries: Whenever the attuned creature finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain no benefits from the rest.

entries.name: Speechless
entries: The attuned creature can't speak.

entries.name: Unfortunate
entries: Whenever the target rolls a 20 on the {@dice d20} of a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, the roll instead becomes a 1.

entries.name: Vulnerable
entries: The attuned creature has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to one damage type (choose when you cast this spell).

name: Curse of Aging
entries: A creature you touch must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be cursed to age and wither. While cursed, the target ages at ten times the normal rate, becoming ten days older for each day that passes. Additionally, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and saving throws.

name: Curse of Binding

components.m: a body part from the intended target, such as a fingernail, a lock of hair, or a drop of blood

entries: You attempt to bind a creature or object to a location. Choose a target and a point within range that you can see. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be cursed to remain within 30 feet of the point. If the target starts its turn further than 30 feet from the point, it must succeed on a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC or be dragged 60 feet toward the point. Additionally, if the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the attempt fails and wastes the spell or effect. On a success, the spell ends.

name: Curse of Blades
entries: You attempt to drive a creature you can see within range to violence. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be cursed and have the Frenzied condition for the duration.

A creature with the Frenzied condition loses the ability to distinguish between friend and foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies. While Frenzied, the creature chooses the targets for its attacks, spells, and abilities randomly from among the creatures it can see within range, and it must make an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} if any creature provokes one.
At the end of its turn, an affected creature can repeat its saving throw, ending the spell early on a success.

name: Curse of Chains
entries: A black brand resembling iron shackles appears on a creature you can see within range, which must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be cursed for the duration. While cursed, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 and can't increase. The target can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, the spell ends.

name: Curse Ward
entries: You reach out your hand and touch a willing creature, raising a smoke-like barrier around it. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage and can't be cursed or possessed. If the target is already under one of these effects, the effect is suppressed until the spell ends.

name: Dead Fog
entries: A 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of necromantic fog appears centered on a point you can see within range.
