The fog lasts for the duration or until strong wind (such as the one created by {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}) disperses it, ending the spell. Its area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}.

Each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. When you cast the spell, you can empower it with your own life force. You can choose to take 10, 20, or 30 Necrotic damage. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}. When you do so, the spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for every 10 Necrotic damage you take, up to a maximum of {@dice 10d6}.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can move the fog up to 30 feet. A creature also makes a save against this spell when the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} moves into its space and when it enters the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Dead Mist Lash
entries: You lash out at a creature you can see within range with a glowing white tendril formed of the sinister, necromantic Dead Mists. Make a ranged spell attack roll against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} Necrotic damage.

When you deal damage with the spell, you can also drain some of your life essence to deal extra Necrotic damage to the target. You can choose to take 5, 10, or 15 Necrotic damage. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}. When you do so, the spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for every 5 Necrotic damage you take, up to a maximum of {@dice 10d8}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Defenestration
entries: A wave of force erupts from your open hand, hurling a creature you can see within range through a window. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is pushed up to 20 feet and thrown through a window of your choice. If there is no window within 20 feet of the target, it is instead pushed up to 20 feet in a direction of your choice and thrown through a window of arcane force, which materializes behind the creature and vanishes after it shatters. The target takes {@damage 4d6} Slashing damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition when it is thrown through a window. On a successful save, the target is instead only pushed 10 feet and takes no damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} and the distance the target is pushed on a success or failure increases by 5 feet for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Delay
entries: You briefly slow time for a creature of your choice that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be moved to last place in the {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} order from the start of the next round onwards.

name: Demand

components.m: a snake's tongue and a piece of copper wire

entries: This spell projects a select Enchantment spell to a target, regardless of distance. When you cast {@spell Charm Monster|XPHB}, {@spell Charm Person|XPHB}, {@spell Command|XPHB}, {@spell Dominate Beast|XPHB}, {@spell Dominate Person|XPHB}, {@spell Geas|XPHB}, or {@spell Suggestion|XPHB}, before this spell ends, you modify its casting so that its range becomes unlimited. This spell then ends.

Choose a target with which you are familiar (whether or not you can see it) for the Enchantment spell. If the spell requires a verbal command, the creature hears the command in its mind and recognizes you as the sender if it knows you.

You can project the spell across any distance, and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a {@chance 5} chance that the Enchantment spell fails and has no effect.

name: Dire Warning
entries: You receive a message of up to 6 words from yourself in the future, warning you of a critical threat or pointing you toward a fruitful avenue. The GM determines this message. At some point in the future, once you have learned why you sent the message, you must perform a ritual over the course of 10 minutes, which can be done during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, to deliver the message back in time to your past self. If you cast this spell and receive no message, it indicates that you will never complete the ritual in the future, possibly owing to your death or another hindrance.
Once you cast this spell, you can't cast it again for 7 days or until you perform its ritual.

name: Divine Wrath
entries: You deliver a mote of divine wrath to a point you can see within range. Each creature you choose in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d10} Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice), or half as much damage on a successful save. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the creature is disintegrated into salt and everything it was wearing or carrying falls in its space. The target can be revived only by a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Eldritch Orb
entries: You fling a ball of eldritch energy at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Force damage and explodes in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each creature other than the target within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking half the amount of Force damage on a failed save, or none on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

name: Elemental Curse
entries: A spark leaps from your finger to a creature you touch, spreading in bright cracks across its skin. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be cursed for the duration. The cursed target has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to your choice of {@item Acid|XPHB}, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. If the creature has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage type, it instead loses that {@spell Resistance|XPHB}. If the target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the chosen damage type, it instead has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage type.

name: Ethereal Jaunt
entries: A willing creature you touch briefly steps into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn. The spell ends instantly if the target is already on that plane.

While on the Ethereal Plane, the target can only affect and be affected only by creatures, objects, and effects on that plane. It can perceive the plane it left, which looks gray, and it can't see anything there more than 60 feet away. Creatures that aren't on the Ethereal Plane can't perceive or interact with the target unless a feature gives them the ability to do so. The target can move in any direction on the Ethereal Plane. If it moves up or down, every foot of movement costs an extra foot.

When the spell ends, the target returns to the plane it left in the spot that corresponds to its space in the Border Ethereal. If it appears in an occupied space, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Exhume
entries: Choose an unoccupied 20-foot square on the ground within range. This spell causes one pile of Humanoid bones to rise out of the ground within that square. If you cast this spell within a burial place such as a graveyard, mausoleum, or barrow, {@dice 1d4} corpses or piles of bones are exhumed. The ground itself isn't disturbed by this spell; the bones simply appear out of the ground.

name: Eye of Anubis
entries: A beam of moonlight streaks from each of your eyes. Make two spell attack rolls directed at one target or two different targets within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d4} Necrotic damage and has a {@dice 1d4} penalty on the next attack roll it makes before spell ends at the start of your next turn. This penalty is {@dice 1d6} if you hit the target with both spell attack rolls.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage of each beam increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d4}), 11 ({@dice 3d4}), and 17 ({@dice 4d4}).

name: Eye of Ra
entries: A beam of sunlight streaks from each of your eyes. Make two spell attack rolls directed at one target or two different targets within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d4} Radiant damage and the next attack roll against it with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} before the start of your next turn has a {@dice 1d4} bonus. This bonus is {@dice 1d6} if you hit the target with both spell attack rolls.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage of each beam increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d4}), 11 ({@dice 3d4}), and 17 ({@dice 4d4}).

name: Face Swap
entries: You place an {@condition invisible} sigil on a willing target you can see within range. This sigil lasts until the spell ends.

For the duration, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to project your face onto the marked creature until you dismiss the effect (no action required). When you do so, you can see, hear, and speak through the marked creature as if you occupied its space. You use your senses instead of those of the marked creature.

name: Finger Guns
entries: You extend your forefinger and thumb, a dangerous gesture mimicking a gun. For the duration, your hand counts as a Simple Ranged weapon with a range of 60/240 feet and the {@itemMastery Slow|XPHB} mastery property. You can use your spellcasting ability instead of Dexterity for the attack rolls of this weapon. On a hit, the weapon deals {@damage 2d6} Force damage and doesn't add your ability modifier to damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The weapon's normal range increases by 30 feet and its long range increases by 120 feet when you reach levels 5 (90/360 feet), 11 (120/480 feet), and 17 (150/600 feet).

name: Flashback
entries: Casting your mind through time, you make a subtle alteration to history, allowing you to make preparations for the current situation within the last 24 hours. Describe to your GM how the precautions you took ahead of time to affect the current situation. For example, you might have packed a particular piece of gear or arranged for a distraction to occur at this exact moment. The GM might call for an ability check if the preparations are sufficiently challenging; on a failure, the spell fails and has no effect.

A Flashback's effects are limited, as reality reasserts itself with the fewest possible changes to accommodate the alteration in history. The spell can't remove creatures or objects from an encounter, harm a creature, or cause creatures and objects that aren't being worn or carried by you to move. It can generally add an element to an encounter, but can't generally subtract them. The GM decides on the extent of the Flashback's effect.

name: Flawed Reconstruction
entries: You stitch together the wounds of a creature you touch, which regains {@dice 3d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. However, the mending is imperfect, and the target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by {@dice 1d6}, to a minimum of 1.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing increases by {@dice 2d6} and the reduction increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Flawed Resurrection

components.m: a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust

entries: You touch a dead Humanoid that has dead been no longer than 10 days and revive it as an intelligent Undead creature. The creature returns to life with 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. This spell closes all mortal wounds, but it doesn't restore missing body parts.

The creature's type becomes Undead and it gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. It doesn't need to eat, drink, sleep, or breathe, though it must still rest for 8 hours to gain the benefits of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

The Undead body deteriorates over time. Whenever the creature finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum permanently decreases by 1. The creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum can only be restored by the {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} spell. If the creature dies and is later targeted by {@spell Resurrection|XPHB} or similar magic, it can be returned to life with its original creature type.

name: Force Buckler

m.text: a specially-prepared gauntlet worth 5+ GP

entries: You summon a translucent field of force, which springs forth from the gauntlet used in the spell's casting. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +2 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} while you aren't wielding a {@item Shield|XPHB}. This spell ends early if you are hit by an attack.

name: Force Dart

m.text: a specially-prepared gauntlet worth 5+ GP

entries: You fling a dart of magical force at a creature within range. Make a Ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d10} Force damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d10}), 11 ({@dice 3d10}), and 17 ({@dice 4d10}).

name: Force Weapon

m.text: a specially-prepared gauntlet worth 5+ GP

entries: You conjure a blade of magical force in the air, which strikes at a creature within range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d10} Force damage. The blade remains in existence for a short time; until the start of your next turn, you can make a single strike with your mystical blade as an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: You make an additional attack when you reach levels 5 (2 attacks), 11 (3 attacks), and 17 (4 attacks). These attacks can target the same creature or different ones.

name: Free Throw
entries: Choose an object that weighs 5 pounds or less within 30 feet of yourself that isn't being worn or carried. This spell launches the object at a creature or a point within the spell's range. You choose the object's exact trajectory, allowing it to navigate around obstacles and corners. The target creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d4} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The target gains no benefit from {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} or {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover} for this save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 2d4} and the maximum weight of the thrown object increases by 5 pounds for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Frenzy
entries: With a gesture, you reduce a crowd to base instinct and violence. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the Frenzied condition for the duration.

A creature with the Frenzied condition loses the ability to distinguish between friend and foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies. While Frenzied, the creature chooses the targets for its attacks, spells, and abilities randomly from among the creatures it can see within range, and it must make an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} if any creature provokes one.
At the end of its turn, an affected creature can repeat its saving throw, ending the condition on itself early on a success.

name: Frigid Blade

m.text: a Melee weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP

entries: Encasing the weapon used in the spell's casting in ice, you make one melee attack. The attack uses your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. The weapon's damage die increases by 1 step ({@dice d4} → {@dice d6} → {@dice d8} → {@dice d10} → {@dice d12} or {@dice 2d6}, your choice). The weapon's damage dice don't increase if it has more than one weapon damage die. If the attack deals damage, it can be Cold damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: Whether you deal Cold damage or the weapon's normal damage type, the attack deals extra Cold damage when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 1d6}), 11 ({@dice 2d6}), and 17 ({@dice 3d6}).

name: Frolicking Fountain
entries: You conjure a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} of water that swirls in a hypnotic motion in an unoccupied space within range. When the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} appears and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on subsequent turns, you can command the water to lash out in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the water. Each creature you choose within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} makes a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 5d6} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
When a creature tries to leave the area, you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the start of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 5.

name: Gahoul's Glorious Gothic

m.text: a decorated gothic manor miniature worth 1,000+ GP

entries: A rift opens, pouring forth tons of brick and stonework that neatly assembles into a vast gothic estate. The estate consists of a manor surrounded by a 200-by-200-foot courtyard and a 10-foot tall wrought iron fence around the perimeter. Any creature within the estate's area is escorted away by harmless but forceful specters.

You can create any floor plan you like for the manor, but the space can't exceed 50 contiguous 10-foot Cubes or contain more than five floors. The manor is adorned with barred windows and decorative gargoyles, but is furnished and decorated as you choose. Once the manor is first created, these details are recorded in the miniature manor used to cast the spell and can't be changed. The manor contains sufficient food to feed up to 100 people for seven days. Furnishings and other objects created by this spell dissipate into smoke if taken beyond the estate's perimeter.

The manor is staffed by 50 {@creature Skeleton|XMM|Skeletons} obedient to you. The skeletons can perform any task a normal human servant could perform, but they can't attack or take any action that would directly harm another creature. Any Humanoid buried in the manor's courtyard rises 24 hours later as a {@creature Ghoul|XMM} indefinitely under your control. You can have up to 10 such ghouls at once. If given no instructions, these ghouls patrol the estate. Any Undead created by this spell dies if it leaves the estate's perimeter.

When the spell ends, the manor is magically drawn back into the rift. If you cast the spell once every seven days for 365 days in the same location, the manor becomes permanent and can't be dispelled.

name: Gahoul's Scapegoat
entries: You trace a complex arcane symbol on the flesh of a willing creature you touch, marking it for sacrifice. When you are hit by an attack roll during the spell's duration and the marked creature is within 60 feet of yourself, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to teleport, swapping places with the creature and forcing it to be hit by the attack instead of you. The spell then ends.

name: Gahoul's Shrieking Skull
entries: You throw a cackling skull at a point you can see within range, which emits a mortifying shriek audible out to 300 feet. Each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} takes {@damage 3d4} Thunder damage, without making a saving throw.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d4} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Gahoul's Spectral Scythe
entries: You conjure a whirling phantasmal scythe in your open hand and throw it through the air. The scythe travels in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}, coming to rest hovering in the air at the end of its line or before it strikes a solid surface. Each creature within the area while the scythe is moving makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d8} Necrotic damage on failed save or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on this saving throw if the scythe comes to rest in the creature's space.

If you are within 120 feet of the scythe at the start of your next turn, it returns to you in a 10-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}, forcing creatures within its area of travel to make the save against it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

name: Game of Fate
entries: You magically compel a creature within range that can hear and understand you to a nonmagical game with vital consequences. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to join you in the game.

The loser of the game takes {@damage 6d6} Psychic damage. If no player has won or lost by the end of the spell's duration, both you and the target take this damage. If you or one of your allies harms the target, you forfeit the game, and vice versa if the target or one of its allies harms you. Additionally, you and the target creature can negotiate for greater stakes. You can wager for higher Psychic damage (up to a maximum of {@dice 12d6}), currency, property, or more esoteric rewards, such as bestowal of a noble title. The spell reveals if a creature attempts to place a bet it can't fulfill. A bet is finalized when you and the target agree on the bet, solidifying the bet with a handshake or similar gesture. Property or currency bet on the game is teleported to the winner at the game's conclusion. The loser is also magically compelled to take any action (such as bestowing a noble title) wagered as part of a bet.
Lastly, no spell, magical effect, or creature other than you and the target can influence the game's outcome.

name: Geomantic Discernment
entries: You gain the ability to sense valuable minerals in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. A glowing aura that only you can see appears around valuable metals, gems, ores, native elements, or other resources in that {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the spell's duration. You can see this aura through any amount of nonmagical material.

name: Grasp of the Grave
entries: Spectral skeletal arms emerge from the ground in a 15-foot-radius circle on the ground that you can see within range. The area becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for the duration.

Each creature you choose in the area makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d6} Force damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. Whenever a creature you can see enters the area or ends its turn there, you can force it to make a save against the spell. A creature makes that save only once per turn.
When a creature tries to leave the area, you can force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the start of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Gravity Well
entries: A 15-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of gravitational force forms centered on a point you choose within range. Choose whether the direction of gravity is inward toward the center of the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} or outward away from it. Each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d8} Force damage and is pulled 15 feet toward the center of the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} or is pushed 15 feet away from it, according to the direction you chose. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Halo of Flame
entries: A ring of flame ignites above your head and emits heat in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Whenever the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} enters the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 2d8} Fire damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Hangover
entries: You emit a drunken aura that quickly washes away, leaving an intense hangover. A creature you choose within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 3d8} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only. The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws it makes to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} as a result of this damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Hex: Abate
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target can't make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

name: Hex: Apathy
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes {@variantrule Indifferent [Attitude]|XPHB|Indifferent} about creatures of your choice that it is {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or is forced to make a saving throw. When the spell ends at the end of your next turn, the creature's attitude returns to normal.

name: Hex: Bleeding
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, each time the target takes damage until the spell ends at the end of your next turn, it takes an extra {@damage 1d4} Necrotic damage. If the target is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, it takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage instead.

name: Hex: Blood Curse
entries: A creature you can see within range becomes cursed until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. If the target takes damage while cursed and has fewer than 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} after taking damage, it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The threshold of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} under which the target drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} increases by 5 when you reach levels 5 (10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}), 11 (15 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}), and 17 (20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}).

name: Hex: Charm
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} if you or your {@variantrule Ally|XPHB|Allies} are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. The spell ends early if you or your {@variantrule Ally|XPHB|Allies} deal damage to the target. When the spell ends, the target knows it was {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you.

name: Hex: Decay
entries: One creature you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}. The creature takes this damage again at the end of each of its turns. The spell ends at the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

name: Hex: Disorient
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must subtract {@dice 1d4} from attack rolls it makes until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The die subtracted from attack rolls changes when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 1d6}), 11 ({@dice 1d8}), and 17 ({@dice 1d10}).

name: Hex: Doomward
entries: You touch a willing creature. The first time the target would drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} before the spell ends at the end of your next turn, the target instead drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}, and the spell ends. This spell has no effect if you have cast this spell on the target within the past 24 hours.

name: Hex: Duplicity
entries: You create an illusory duplicate of yourself in your space. When a creature hits you with an attack before the spell ends at the end of your next turn, roll a {@dice d6}. On 4 or higher, the attack strikes the duplicate instead of you and the spell ends. The duplicate otherwise ignore all other damage and effects. A creature is unaffected by this spell if it has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition, {@sense Blindsight|XPHB}, or {@sense Truesight|XPHB}.

name: Hex: Evil Eye
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

name: Hex: Fortune
entries: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends at the end of your next turn, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws.

name: Hex: Garble
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't speak coherently or cast spells with a Verbal component until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

name: Hex: Hallucination
entries: One creature you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer from hallucinations until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. Whenever a hallucinating target makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to give the roll {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

name: Hex: Hobble
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced to 10 feet until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. If the target is flying, it falls, unless it has the ability to hover.

name: Hex: Imperil
entries: You gesture at a creature you can see within range and choose a damage type. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or lose {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage type, if it has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to it. If it has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to that damage type, it instead has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to it. The spell ends at the end of your next turn.

name: Hex: Mire
entries: You transform the ground in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you into murky swamp, which is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. This {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} doesn't cost you extra movement.

name: Hex: Misfortune
entries: Choose one creature you can see within range. Until the spell ends at the end of your next turn, whenever the target rolls a 20 on the {@dice d20} of a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, the roll instead becomes a 1.

name: Hex: Musical Interlude
entries: With an uplifting speech or an encouraging musical number, each creature you choose in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you gains {@dice 1d6} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. These {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} last until this spell ends at the end of your next turn, but vanish early for a creature that ends its turn outside of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} increase by {@dice 1d6} when you reach level 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

name: Hex: Obfuscate
entries: You produce fog in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. The fog spreads around corners, and its area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}. This fog lasts until the spell ends at the end of your next turn or until a strong wind (such as one created by {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}) disperses it, ending the spell.

name: Hex: Peacebond
entries: You create a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you that locks weapons to their containers. The weapons and ammunition of each creature within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} become fixed in their sheaths, quivers, or holsters until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. A creature can take a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, freeing an item from its container on a success.

name: Hex: Pox
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

name: Hex: Ruin
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has a -2 penalty to AC until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The penalty to AC increases by 1 when you reach levels 5 (-3), 11 (-4), and 17 (-5).

name: Hex: Stupor
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect. Once the spell ends on a target, it is immune to this spell for the next 24 hours.

name: Hex: Sweet Tooth
entries: You touch a nonmagical object within range that isn't being worn or carried and that can fit within a 1-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. It transforms into an edible candy replica. You choose the type of candy it is made out of, such as gingerbread, candy cane, licorice, or a combination of various candies. If the candy is not eaten or destroyed when the spell ends at the end of your next turn, it reverts to its original material. Once the spell ends on a target, it is immune to this spell for 1 minute.

name: Hex: Tremors
entries: A miniature earthquake shakes the ground in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Each creature on the ground in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. A creature that enters the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall {@condition Prone|XPHB}. This spell ends at the end of your next turn.

name: Hex: Vanish
entries: Repeating an ancient chant, you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. Creatures within 20 feet of yourself that can hear can detect your location for the spell's duration. The spell ends early if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.

name: Hex: Ward
entries: You touch a willing creature. Each time the target takes damage before the spell ends at the end of your next turn, the damage it takes is reduced by 2.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage reduction increases by 1 when you reach levels 5 (-3), 11 (-4) and 17 (-5).

name: Hocuspocus
entries: You conjure minor paranormal phenomena and other ominous effects. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its effects active at a time.

entries.name: Grave Mists
entries: A rolling fog gathers on the ground in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} for 1 minute.

entries.name: Ominous Lights
entries: You cause all candles, torches, and other open flames to darken and flicker for 1 minute.

entries.name: Paranormal Chill
entries: You can chill or warm the air in a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} by 10 degrees for 1 minute.

entries.name: Poltergeist Activity
entries: You cause small, unattended objects to rattle or levitate an inch off the ground for 1 minute.

entries.name: Spirit Orbs
entries: You create up to four fist-sized spectral, glowing orbs, which float around within range for 1 minute. The orbs don't provide light, apart from a dim glow.

entries.name: Spooky Noises
entries: You create a quiet sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as ominous whispers, the drone of insects, or the sound of crying. The sound lasts for 1 minute.

name: Hollowing Curse
entries: Tendrils of vitality-draining mist extend from your fingertips. A creature you can see within range makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage and is cursed for the duration. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

On each of your subsequent turns, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to deal damage to the cursed creature. The damage equals {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage if you took the {@action Magic|XPHB} action or half as much if you took a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 2d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Hunger of the Earth
entries: The ground opens up beneath a creature you choose on the ground within range. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled underground for the duration. On a successful save, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the start of your next turn.

A creature pulled underground has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, can't teleport, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the ground, and takes {@damage 4d6} Bludgeoning damage at the end of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Icicle Javelin
entries: You fling a massive icicle toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes {@damage 3d8} Cold damage. If the target is also adjacent to a wall, or a similar fixed object, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Identity Curse
entries: You touch a creature's temple and attempt to erase its identity. One creature you touch makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition for 1 hour and is cursed to forget its identity. When the target awakens, it loses all its personal memories, though it retains its general knowledge, proficiencies, and other statistics. The target doesn't realize it has any class features, feats, or magical abilities, and so doesn't willingly use them unless it rediscovers them. If left to its own devices, the target will quickly adopt a new name and begin to build a new identity. When the spell ends, the target regains its past memories.

name: Impressions of the Past

m.text: an hourglass and a glass eye worth 100+ GP

entries: You cast your senses back in time to perceive your current location as it was at some point in the past, including any events that were happening at that time. You must specify the exact time you wish to see, which can't be more than 100 years ago. The past appears dreamlike and shadowy. While viewing the past, you can look in any direction, discern detail, and hear speech as normal, but you can't move or speak.

name: Inevitable Boulder
entries: A Large 8-foot-diameter boulder appears in an unoccupied space within range and begins to roll in pursuit of one creature that you can see. The boulder has AC 18, 100 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. If the boulder is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it vanishes and the spell ends.

At the start of each of your turns, the boulder moves 60 feet in the direction of its target. If the boulder enters a creature's space, the creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 6d10} Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage only. The boulder also crushes nonmagical objects smaller than itself in its path. If the boulder reaches its target, it rolls over it and continues on, moving until it completes its movement or reaches an obstacle larger than itself. The boulder pursues its target for the duration, rolling over it more than once if possible.

If you maintain your {@status Concentration|XPHB} on this spell for the entire possible duration, the boulder continues to pursue its target for up to 1 hour or until you dismiss it. The spell no longer requires your {@status Concentration|XPHB} for this duration. Once the boulder strikes its target, it vanishes and the spell ends.

name: Inexorable Sarcophagus

m.text: a miniature sarcophagus worth 1,000+ GP

entries: You toss a palm-sized sarcophagus at a Large or small creature you can see within range, which must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw as the sarcophagus grows to full size and attempts to trap it within. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0, and it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from attacks and effects outside of the sarcophagus for the duration.

The sarcophagus is an object of the same size as the target creature with AC 15 and 100 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. It has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. If it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the spell ends.
A target within the sarcophagus makes another Dexterity saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

If it successfully saves against this spell three times, it escapes the sarcophagus and the spell ends. If it fails its saves three times, the sarcophagus crushes it and deals 100 Bludgeoning damage to it. The successes and failures needn't be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.
A creature killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a Mummy that follows your verbal orders.

name: Instant Replay

time.condition: which you take immediately after missing a target with an attack

entries: As your attack misses the target, you instantly reset yourself to the moment before the attack and repeat the attack roll against the same target, potentially causing it to hit.

name: Intensify Gravity
entries: This spell intensifies gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within range.

A creature in the area must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. Combined with {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, a creature must spend 3 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. If a creature with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition attempts to right itself, it must succeed on a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a failure, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the end of the current turn.

Objects in the area, including those being worn or carried, weigh double their usual weight. This may cause creatures to become encumbered or cause spells with a weight limit, such as {@spell Levitate|XPHB}, to fail.
The {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of a creature in an area of high gravity is reduced to 0.
Lastly, creatures and objects take double damage from falling.

name: Intrusive Thought

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within range hits a target with an attack roll

entries: You attempt to distort a creature's thinking. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or automatically miss with the triggering attack.

name: Invisibility Purge
entries: You release a burst of magic to disrupt invisibility in a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from yourself. Each {@condition Invisible|XPHB} creature and object within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is outlined with a magical aura and can't benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for the duration. An affected creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

name: Jam Weapon

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within range makes an attack using a Ranged weapon

entries: The weapon you target suffers a malfunction and the attack fails. A malfunctioning weapon can't be used to make an attack until a creature takes the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to fix the weapon malfunction.

name: Jethro's Instant Reload
entries: One Ranged weapon you touch becomes enchanted to reload itself automatically. If the weapon has the {@itemProperty DM-C|DarkMatter24|Cooldown}, {@itemProperty LD|XPHB|Loading}, or {@itemProperty RLD|XDMG|Reload}, you ignore the property for the duration. When the weapon's ammunition is depleted, ammunition you are carrying teleports into the weapon.

name: Lashing Tendrils

components.m: the tip of an octopus tentacle

entries: You sprout grotesque tendrils that {@item whip|XPHB} around in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Whenever the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} enters the space of a creature and whenever a creature enters the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} or ends its turn there, you can deal {@damage 2d4} Bludgeoning damage to that creature. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d4} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Legendary Libation

components.m: a container, such as a glass, mug, or flask

entries: A container of your choice magically fills with a drink, such as ale or tea, which can be imbibed as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action. A creature that consumes the drink gains {@dice 1d6} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. The drink's benefits, including the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, last until the start of the creature's next turn. If the drink isn't consumed, it vanishes at the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} increase by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

name: Lightning Surge
entries: A dazzling array of lightning bolts erupts from you. Each creature within a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} Lightning damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

name: Magic Daggers
entries: With a flourish, you conjure two daggers composed of magical force and flick them at targets within range. You can throw the daggers at one target or multiple within range. Make a separate ranged spell attack roll for each dagger, dealing {@damage 1d6} Force damage on a hit. The daggers vanish after the attack.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: This spell creates an additional dagger and you make an additional attack when you reach level 5 (3 attacks), 11 (4 attacks), and 17 (5 attacks).

name: Mandy's Enchanted Carriage
entries: You shape-shift a vegetable into a Large magical carriage, complete with reins and two quasi-real horses. The carriage is luxurious and carries up to six passengers—four within and two atop it at the coach's seat. Creatures within the carriage have {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from external effects, but can see outside through a pair of windows composed of magical force. While sitting in the coach's seat, a creature can control the carriage, which has a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 100 feet and can travel 10 miles in an hour, or 13 miles at a fast pace.
The carriage and horses count as a single object with 12 AC and 100 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The spell ends early if the carriage and horses are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Duration
entries: This spell's duration varies depending upon when and where it was cast. If cast in a location where time passes normally, the spell lasts until the twelfth stroke of the next midnight, however long that may be. Elsewhere, the spell lasts for 24 hours. When the spell ends, the carriage's occupants are ejected into adjacent unoccupied spaces, the carriage shrinks back into a vegetable, and the quasi-real horses vanish.

name: Mandy's Feral Follower
entries: You touch a Medium or smaller Beast, which shape-shifts into a Humanoid with an appearance of your choice. The Beast's statistics are replaced by the stat block of a {@creature Commoner|XMM} but retains its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}. You choose the Commoner's skill proficiency. The commoner wears {@item Fine Clothes|XPHB} but has no other equipment, and has a basic understanding of all unskilled tasks.

The target gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. The spell ends early on the target if it has no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} left. When the spell ends, the {@item Fine Clothes|XPHB} dissipate into smoke.

entries.name: Combat
entries: The commoner is an ally to you and your allies. It rolls its own {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} and acts on its own turn. It behaves as though it is dutifully employed by you.

entries.name: Duration
entries: This spell's duration varies depending upon when and where it was cast. If cast in a location where time passes normally, the spell lasts until the twelfth stroke of the next midnight, however long that may be. Elsewhere, the spell lasts for 24 hours.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can shape-shift one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Mandy's Marvelous Dress

m.text: a glass slipper worth 100+ GP

entries: A willing creature you touch is instantly clothed in a fabulous ball gown, perfectly tailored and complete with a set of glittering jewelry. You can choose for the dress to sit atop the creature's clothing or armor, or for it to magically replace its outfit. The creature can't remove the dress until the spell ends; similarly, the jewelry vanishes if it is removed.

entries.name: Elegant Flair
entries: Until the spell ends, when the wearer makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} using Charisma, it can replace the number it rolls with a 10.

entries.name: Glamorous Ward
entries: If the wearer of the dress is attacked by a creature that can see it, the attacker must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or miss with the attack. On a success, the attacker is immune to this effect until the spell ends.

entries.name: Duration
entries: This spell's duration varies depending upon when and where it was cast. If cast in a location where time passes normally, the spell lasts until the twelfth stroke of the next midnight, however long that may be. Elsewhere, the spell lasts for 24 hours. When the spell ends, the dress vanishes in a puff of sparkles, and the creature becomes clothed in its original outfit.

name: Map

m.text: Ink Pen, Paper, and ink worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: This spell magically generates a gridded {@item Map|XPHB} of an area you choose within range. The Map shows a 50-foot Square area on a 5-foot grid and includes scale-accurate details of non-moving objects in that area. The map is rendered without color, and doesn't include secret doors, traps, or creatures. In a multi-level structure, the map only details the level on which the spell is cast.

name: Mass Skirmish
entries: You enhance the mobility of up to six willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range. For the duration, each target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is doubled, its movement is unaffected by {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and it doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

name: Memorize

m.text: silver string worth 10+ GP, tied in a knot, which the spell consumes

entries: When you cast this spell, your eyes pass over a page of written text that is committed to your memory. For the next year, you remember the exact details of all information on the page. After that time, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all Intelligence checks you make to recall this information.

name: Might of the Abyss

components.m: a small, black strip of ribbon

entries: You channel power from the Lower Planes, enhancing three creatures other than yourself within range. Whenever it deals damage with a weapon, it deals an extra {@damage 1d4} Necrotic damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Minor Lifesteal
entries: You attempt to drain life energy from a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage. You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the amount of Necrotic damage dealt.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

name: Moment to Think
entries: When you cast this spell, you briefly stop time for everyone but yourself. You can take one additional action and move around in your space while no time passes for other creatures. That action can be used only to take the {@action Search|XPHB}, {@action Study|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action. Furthermore, you can't affect or damage any creature or object, other than objects you are wearing or carrying. If an object leaves your hand, it also becomes frozen in time.

name: Nondescript
entries: This spell makes you seem unremarkable, though it doesn't change your actual appearance. Creatures that see or hear you for the duration are unable to recall your appearance or voice.

name: Paradox
entries: By twisting the flow of time into knots, you cause one action of your choice taken within range within the last round to be undone. Reality then reasserts itself, recoiling from the damage caused by removing an event from time. The direct effects of that action, such as damage dealt by an attack or spell, are undone, but the indirect effects, such as creatures choosing to move to different locations, are not. The creature that took the action takes {@damage 10d8} Psychic damage, as it copes with its history being modified.

name: Perforating Shot

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting or missing with a ranged attack using a weapon

entries: As your attack hits or misses the target, the weapon or ammunition transforms into a 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} of magical energy that extends out to the weapon's normal range. The {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} includes the attack's original target. Each creature within the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Force damage equal to the weapon's normal damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The weapon's damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 1.

name: Petal Storm
entries: An elemental force of swirling winds fills a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} and you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on later turns to move the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} up to 30 feet.

When the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} appears, each creature in it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage or half as much damage on a successful save. The damage increases by {@dice 1d6}, to a maximum of {@dice 4d6}, whenever you take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to move the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. A creature also makes the save when the spell's area moves into its space and when it enters the spell's area or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The base and maximum damage increase by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Phantasmal Beauty
entries: You tap into the dreams of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest desires, visible only to that creature. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions and a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0 for the duration.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw whenever it takes damage and at the end of each of its turns for the duration. On a successful save, it takes {@damage 4d10} Psychic damage and the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Phantom Grapnel
entries: You conjure a chain and hook made of magical force, which you propel at a creature or unoccupied space you can see within range. When you target a space or a creature of Huge size or larger, your grapnel pulls you to that target in a straight line. You provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} for this movement as normal. When you target a creature of Large size or smaller, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet toward you.

name: Pharaoh's Curse
entries: Opening your palm, you release a puff of dust containing the pestilence of mummy rot. One creature you choose within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be cursed for the duration. While cursed, the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, and its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by {@dice 3d6} every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by this curse.

name: Pit Trap
entries: This spell magically creates a {@trap hidden pit|XDMG} trap at an unoccupied space you can see on the ground within range. The 5-foot square lid of the trap looks identical to the surrounding floor. The pit drops 10 feet into an extradimensional space. If the pit extends into an open space below the lid, such as a lower floor, the pit opens into that space instead.

As a Study action, a creature can examine the section of floor that forms the pit's lid and make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, detecting the pit on a successful check.

When a Large or smaller creature moves onto the lid, it swings open like a trapdoor. The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw or falls into the pit, taking {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it falls. On a successful save, the creature moves to a space next to the lid without falling. A creature that falls into the pit can climb or fly out as normal.
The spell ends 1 minute after a creature falls into the pit. When the spell ends, the extradimensional space vanishes and creatures or objects within the pit are deposited at the top of the pit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The pit is 10 feet deeper for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Polybrachia
entries: Two muscular arms of brilliant arcane energy appear on a willing creature that you touch. These arms are fully functional and can be used to wield weapons and Shields (allowing the target to simultaneously hold 2 two-handed weapons, or 4 one-handed weapons), perform Somatic components of spells, and perform other actions. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks. The target can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make a melee attack using a weapon wielded by the arms.

name: Prehensile Hair
entries: When you cast this spell, you can cause any of your body hair to grow up to 15 feet in length. Your hair becomes supernaturally tough and you can magically use it to extend your reach for the duration. Using your hair, you can cast spells with a range of Touch, take the {@action Help|XPHB} or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, or perform simple tasks out to a range of 15 feet. Your hair can't wield weapons, {@item Shield|XPHB|Shields}, or carry objects heavier than 10 pounds. Your hair returns to its normal length when this spell ends.

name: Protect Threshold

components.m: an ounce of salt for each foot of the warded portal's perimeter

entries: Tracing arcane sigils along its boundary, you can ward a doorway, window, or other portal from entry. For the duration, an {@condition Invisible|XPHB} eldritch creature stalks the warded portal. Any creature that attempts to pass through the portal makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Psychedelics
entries: For a moment, the colors in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you shift in a rainbow swirl. {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes until Each creature you choose in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has the spell ends at the end of your next turn.
Additionally, the colors of objects you choose within range change randomly and remain brightly and unnaturally colored for 1 hour.

name: Quickstep
entries: This spell imparts a flash of speed. Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Recall
entries: Record your location when you cast this spell. Until the end of your next turn, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} in response to an attack roll, a creature casting a spell, or a creature moving within 5 feet of you to teleport back to that location, or to the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. This teleportation precedes the triggering attack or spell. The spell then ends.

name: Restore Youth

m.text: gold dust worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You perform a complex ritual for a creature you touch, reducing its apparent age by {@dice 2d10} years, to a minimum of 18 years. This spell doesn't extend the creature's lifespan.

name: Rocks Fall
entries: Boulders appear in the air and fall in a 60-foot-radius, 120-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage 10d8} Bludgeoning damage and is buried under the rubble. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.

A buried creature has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, and can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, freeing itself from the boulders and ending the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions on itself on a success.

name: Ruby-Eye Curse
entries: A red haze clouds the eyes of a creature that meets your gaze. A creature you choose within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be cursed for the duration. While cursed, the target can see normally out to a range of 5 feet, but has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition beyond this range.

name: Rumbling Charge
entries: You imbue yourself with the elemental power of a landslide. When you cast this spell, you immediately move up to 30 feet in a straight line on the ground without expending movement or provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}. If you end this movement within 5 feet of a creature, you can force that creature to make a Strength saving throw, taking {@damage 2d12} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d12} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Rumor
entries: You magically spread a rumor of 10 words or less in a 100-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Any creature within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear and understand three or more other creatures believes that they hear the rumor being repeated by someone nearby. Different creatures hear the rumor from different people, so a concrete origin is impossible to discern. Generally, creatures won't become {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} upon hearing even the most vicious rumors, but hearing a rumor can affect their attitude positively or negatively.

name: Rusting Grasp
entries: You conjure a potent acid at your fingertips, which can corrode metal and burn flesh. Make a melee spell attack against a creature or object within your reach. On a hit, a creature takes {@damage 6d4} Acid damage and it has a -3 penalty to its AC, to a minimum of 10, for 1 hour.

If you target a nonmagical metal object with this spell that isn't being worn or carried, you corrode and destroy parts of the object you choose that can fit within a 1-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 2d4} for each spell slot level above 3. If you target a nonmagical object, you can destroy an additional cubic foot for each slot level above 3.

name: Sanction
entries: You fling a drop of blood at a creature you can see within range, which must succeed a Constitution saving throw or be marked for the duration. Whenever you take damage, the marked target takes {@damage 1d8} Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice). The spell ends early if you end your turn more than 30 feet away from the target.

name: Scrutinize Foe
entries: You discern minute details concerning one creature you can see within range. You learn two of the following pieces of information of your choice about the target: its {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, {@variantrule Speed|XPHB|Speeds}, {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities} (if any), {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances} (if any), highest ability score, lowest ability score, and enchantments (which reveals which spells, if any, are currently affecting the target). The GM must share with you the chosen information.

name: Scurry
entries: A nonmagical object you choose within range sprouts legs and runs away. You can't target an object that weighs more than 10 pounds, nor can you target one that is being worn; however, you can target certain objects that are being carried, as long as they aren't affixed entirely around a creature's body or being held in a hand. For example, you can't target a creature's helmet or a sword it is wielding, but you can target a drawstring pouch it is wearing or a dagger that is sheathed at its side.

The object animates, wriggles free of its owner (if it has one), sprouts two legs, and moves 20 feet in a direction you choose. At the start of each of your turns, you can choose which direction the object moves. The object has an AC of 10, if its AC wasn't already higher. The spell ends early if the object is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or is picked up.

name: Secret Enclave
entries: You conjure a shimmering, 10-foot wide multicolored portal within range that leads to a demiplane. When you cast the spell, you also enchant an object that can fit within a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}, which becomes the demiplane's portal key.

The demiplane is a 1,000-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} that resembles a magical forest of the Feywild. The floor is made of fertile soil that can't be burrowed through. The portal into the demiplane and the matching portal out of the demiplane opens only while the portal key is within 60 feet of the portal. Once the demiplane is created, the location of its portal is fixed and it can only be opened from that same location.
You or anyone else within 60 feet of the portal can open the portal by casting this spell again. You can also create a replacement portal key or a duplicate one by casting this spell again.
The portal key and any creature within the demiplane can't be targeted by any Divination spell, though a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell can reveal the location of the portal key.
You can create Secret Enclaves within Secret Enclaves, but only if the original demiplane was created by you.

name: Shriek
entries: You release a blood-curdling screech in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each Large or smaller creature you choose within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is pushed 5 feet away from you.

name: Skirmish
entries: You enhance the mobility of one willing creature you touch, enabling them to move easily through enemy formations. For the duration, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is doubled, its movement is unaffected by {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and it doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

name: Solar Wind
entries: A gust of solar radiance bombards a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d8} Radiant damage and be pushed 10 feet away from you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

name: Sonic Pulse
entries: You compress a thunderous boom into an {@condition invisible} ball and project it at a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 1d8} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.
If the spell's target is within 10 feet of you, the spell is amplified and its damage becomes {@dice 1d10}, instead of {@dice 1d8}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} (or {@dice 1d10}, if amplified) when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8} or {@dice 2d10}), 11 ({@dice 3d8} or {@dice 3d10}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8} or {@dice 4d10}).

name: Soul Effigy
entries: A Humanoid you touch makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a fragment of its soul is bound to the doll used in this spell's casting, which becomes an effigy of that creature. The spell ends if the effigy is destroyed or if the target is on another plane of existence. For the duration, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to do one of the following.

entries.name: Control
entries: You directly control the target's actions and movement on its next turn by manipulating the effigy's limbs. That target can only take the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Hide|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action. While controlled, the target's movements are jerky and unnatural.

entries.name: Harm
entries: You prod the effigy and deal {@damage 2d8} damage to the target. This damage is Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, or another damage type, appropriate to the means by which you harm the effigy. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}.

entries.name: Restrain
entries: You submerge the effigy in water, causing the target to believe it is suffocating. The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Spark of Life
entries: With a quick jolt of necromantic energy, a corpse momentarily rises to obey you. Choose the corpse of a Huge or smaller creature that has died within the last hour. When you cast this spell, the corpse stands up and can move up to 15 feet and make a single melee attack using your spell attack modifier against a target of your choice within its reach. On a hit, this attack deals Bludgeoning damage based on the corpse's size: Tiny ({@dice 1d4}), Small ({@dice 1d6}), Medium ({@dice 1d8}), Large ({@dice 1d10}), and Huge ({@dice 1d12}). Once the corpse attacks, it once again crumples into a heap. A corpse targeted by this spell doesn't become an Undead creature.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by one damage die when you reach levels 5 (2 dice), 11 (3 dice), and 17 (4 dice).

name: Springheel
entries: You flood magic into your legs, allowing you to bound high into the air. Until the start of your next turn, the distance of your {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB|Long} and {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB|High} Jumps increases by 10 feet (this extra distance costs movement as normal), and you suffer no penalty from making a standing jump.

name: Stone Bones
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range. The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

name: Sulfuric Smoke
entries: You create a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} of acidic smoke at a point you can see within range. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d8} Acid damage. The area of the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} with noxious fumes and lasts until the start of your next turn. A creature entirely within the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

name: Sulfuric Smoke
entries: You create a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} of acidic smoke at a point you can see within range. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d8} Acid damage. The area of the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} with noxious fumes and lasts until the start of your next turn. A creature entirely within the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

name: Suspend
entries: You temporarily end one of the following effects on a creature you can see within range. The effect resumes when the spell ends.

items: One of the following conditions: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Petrified|XPHB}, or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}
One spell affecting the target. The duration of the spell is paused and the spellcaster doesn't need to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} until this spell ends.
Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores
Any reduction to the target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum

name: Swift Flight
entries: Streaks of energy flow from the back of a creature you touch, tracing the shapes of wings. The target has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet and can hover until the end of its next turn. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is in the air and nothing is holding it aloft.

name: Sword of Judgment
entries: This spell designates an area of protection in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range. Within that {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, a spectral sword appears over each creature, following the creature as long as it remains within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}.

Whenever a creature within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes an attack or casts a spell, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw, as the sword above it falls. Resolve the Dexterity saving throw before the triggering attack or spell. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 4d8} Force damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

name: Séance

m.text: a crystal ball, deck of tarot cards, or ouija board, and incense worth 50+ GP
